text:
Jules Park: Quick heads-up 1: Novus Health wants a short SLA evidence bundle + a 1-page TCQ (technical checklist) for their infra team before renewal review next Wed. Can we hit EOD Tue? Ticket CS-4922

Ravi Menon: I can grab 90/30/7d uptime + per-route p95/p99. Need tenant id and whether to include per-node breakdown.

Jules Park: Tenant id 112358. Yes include node_id and model_variant for each row. They specifically asked for embed vs generate splits.

Hannah Lee: Onboarding note: Novus opted into prefix caching and a custom TTL during week 1. I'll pull the git diff of the onboarding params and a snippet showing the cache-only requests.

Diego Ramos: From success side, Novus flagged moderate renewal risk; price pushback + wanting clearer credit mechanics. Pack should have a plain-English credit example and a one-line exec summary they can forward to procurement.

Ravi Menon: Uploaded CSV: https://storage.redwood.ai/exports/CS-4922/112358_90d_metrics.csv (7d expiry). Columns: ts,route,latency_ms,p99,p95,tokens_in,tokens_out,node_id,model_variant,status

finance-bot: Note: last invoice cycle indicates usage spike month-over-month + pending committed-cap amendment. Recommend including billing contact in pack.

Jules Park: For TCQ include: link to Dashboard view IDs; kubectl + elasticsearch query examples; steps to trigger a cache miss and confirm prefix cache is returned; explicit list of maintenance exclusions and timezone for measurements.

Hannah Lee: kubectl example to show recent requests for tenant 112358:
```
kubectl logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=48h | grep "tenant=112358" | jq -r '.route + " " + (.latency_ms|tostring)'
```
I'll paste the onboarding config snippet into the ticket.

Ravi Menon: Observations: 90d rolling uptime = 99.92%; generate p99 spikes to ~420ms correlated with requests > 3.5k tokens; embed p99 steady at ~150ms. Calling out token distribution will help procurement understand tail.

Diego Ramos: Drafting the one-line exec summary now (will DM Jules). Keep it positive but factual.

Jules Park: Credit calc paragraph needs to be copy/paste ready. Ravi, can you give a worked example we can include?

Ravi Menon: Example paragraph (ready to drop):
"SLO: 99.9% monthly uptime. Observed: 99.6% for March. Hours in month = 720h. Downtime = (1 - 0.996) * 720h = 2.88h. Per our terms, credit = min((Downtime / SLA_threshold_hours) * monthly_fee, credit_cap). After exclusions and maintenance windows, validated credit amount will be applied to the next invoice following dispute resolution (typically 1-2 billing cycles)."

Hannah Lee: Also adding a short FAQ: Q: "How is uptime measured?" A: "Per-route success rate aggregated across allocated capacity during billing period, excluding pre-agreed maintenance and force majeure." Keep it 2 lines.

Diego Ramos: Procurement won't read long math. Include a tiny table example with numbers (SLO, observed, downtime, sample credit percent). I'll attach the table as an image in the pack.

Jules Park: Action items: 1) Ravi: confirm CSV export + small summary (done) 2) Hannah: onboarding config + validation snippets (in progress) 3) Diego: exec one-liner + table image (due Tue) 4) Jules: assemble final 2-page PDF and upload to CS-4922 (due Tue EOD)

Ravi Menon: One more technical note: they are on quantized small-embed-v3 on Dedicated. Will include exact quant profile (q4_0_perf) and a short note that quantization changes embedding latency by ~10-15ms baseline.

Hannah Lee: Added the cache validation step: use a seeded request to confirm X-Cache: HIT/ MISS headers and show the KV hits metric from the dashboard graph. Snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"tenant":"112358","input":"seeded test"}' -i | grep X-Cache
```

Ravi Menon: Also flagged maintenance exclusions for March 12-13 (region patch window) in the pack.

finance-bot: Reminder: include billing contact (acct-billing@novushealth.com) and the billing cycle for prorations.

Jules Park: Thanks all. I'll compile a concise pack: 1 page evidence (metrics + CSV link + model/quant details), 1 page TCQ (commands + cache validation + how to reproduce latency spikes) + 1-line exec. Uploading once ready.

Diego Ramos: Sending the exec line via DM now.

Jules Park: Uploaded final pack: https://tickets.redwood.ai/cs/CS-4922/evidence_tcq_final.pdf at 1751237890. Please confirm and we'll send to Novus after legal quick-check.

Ravi Menon: Confirmed. Reviewing final PDF now.

Hannah Lee: Review done 1: no issues from onboarding side.

Diego Ramos: Approved from CS. Marking this thread closed pending Novus ack.
